opinions.text:
C. A. 1st Cir. Motion of respondent for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Certiorari denied.

The Chief Justice and Mr. Justice Blackmun would grant the petition and reverse summarily notwithstanding the new statute, N. H. Rev. Stat. Ann., ch. 632-A (Supp. 1977).
